speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. To better understand your condition, can you describe when the tremors started and if they occur more when you are resting or trying to use your hands? Also, have you noticed any changes in your mood, sleep, or appetite recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the tremor improve when you are performing voluntary movements, and have you noticed any stiffness or slowness in your movements? I would also like to know if you have experienced any changes in your sense of smell or have had episodes of falling backward.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Resting tremor worse on the left hand. I also have Soft speech, Reduced facial expressions, Memory decline, Difficulty in managing finances.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any difficulty with balance, such as falling backward, or have you noticed a significant change in your sense of smell? I would also like to know if you have had any episodes of visual hallucinations or excessive daytime sleepiness. REQUEST TEST: DaTscan

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal DaTscan, which rules out Parkinson's disease, your symptoms of resting tremor and cognitive decline are more consistent with Essential Tremor with cognitive impairment or another neurodegenerative condition like Alzheimer's. To differentiate between these, I need to know if you have a family history of tremors or if the tremor affects your head or voice when you speak.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Hypertension, medicated with aspirin and amlodipine. Family history of schizophrenia in his mother. No other significant medical or psychiatric history. Social history: Drinks 1-2 beers nightly and is a former cigar smoker.
